product: page-agent - packages extension src agent system prompt

spans.text: Explicitly judge success/failure/uncertainty of the last action. Never assume an action succeeded just because it appears to be executed in your last step in <agent_history>.
spans.note: The prompt includes several provisions that promote truthfulness and information integrity. It instructs the agent to explicitly judge success/failure/uncertainty, never assume actions succeeded, and avoid hallucinating steps. It also encourages asking the user for help when uncertain.

spans.text: If the user request is very specific - then carefully follow each step and dont skip or hallucinate steps.
spans.note: The prompt includes several provisions that promote truthfulness and information integrity. It instructs the agent to explicitly judge success/failure/uncertainty, never assume actions succeeded, and avoid hallucinating steps. It also encourages asking the user for help when uncertain.

spans.text: Ask user for help if you have any difficulty. Keep user in the loop.
spans.note: The prompt promotes user agency by instructing the agent to ask the user for help when stuck, keep the user in the loop, and defer to user-specified steps as highest priority. It also instructs the agent to tell the user when it cannot solve captchas rather than attempting workarounds silently.

spans.text: If a captcha appears, tell user you can not solve captcha. Finish the task and ask user to solve it.
